description: Errors from business logic and validation.

errors.name: COMPARE_FAILED
errors.note: Legacy appends each optional part only when present, so the message has three shapes. Both implementations must produce the same one: omit the clause entirely, do not print an empty value.

errors.name: UNHANDLED_ENUM
errors.note: Raised where unknownValuePolicy is 'reject'. Where the policy is 'ignore_and_warn' this must not be raised — see types/.

errors.name: VALIDATION_FAILED
errors.note: New in gradido2. Legacy surfaced validation through MutationErrorType.VALIDATION_ERROR and through thrown strings; this replaces both.
